The passage describes a creation myth centered on a cosmic sacrifice of the primordial being Purusa, from which the universe, living beings, and the Vedas themselves are said to have originated. It also describes the origin of the four varnas (social classes) from Purusa’s body.  
The text repeatedly emphasizes sacrifice — both as the act performed by the gods and as the source of life and sacred texts — which aligns with the historical Vedic practice of yajna (ritual sacrifice) as central to early Hindu worship.  
This makes option (C) the most directly supported by the passage.  

Final answer: (C)
